education.description: I focused on deep learning for computer vision and medical image analysis. My thesis on knee osteoarthritis classification was published in a peer-reviewed journal.

experience.description: I work on Snowflake and Databricks implementations for enterprise clients. I'm building a financial analytics platform for a Japanese company and lead its front-end development. I also support technical pre-sales.

Commercial due diligence for Japanese companies buying businesses in IT and other sectors. I built the market and financial models in Excel. I also worked on an internal automation project using Microsoft tools.
I built 2 iOS apps in Swift and SwiftUI with cross-functional teams: FEAR, an augmented-reality app for exposure therapy, and Tetandingan, a 3D guide to traditional offerings.

projects.title: OsteoMaxNet
projects.subtitle: Medical-imaging classifier rebuilt on IBM infrastructure
projects.description: A follow-up to my thesis, rebuilt on IBM infrastructure. The goals are higher classification accuracy and running the model at scale.

projects.title: Knee Osteoarthritis Classification
projects.subtitle: X-ray severity classification with NASNetMobile, published in JAIC
projects.description: My undergraduate thesis at Universitas Ciputra. I tested how different image preprocessing techniques change NASNetMobile's accuracy when it classifies knee osteoarthritis severity from X-rays. The paper was published in the Journal of Applied Informatics and Computing (JAIC).
projects.image_file: MarcellJW - Alt-TA Publikasi Jurnal Poster V2.jpg

projects.title: Used Car Price Prediction
projects.subtitle: Price regression on market data, published in IJCIS
projects.description: A machine learning study that predicts used-car prices from market data, built in Python with Pandas. The paper was published in the International Journal of Computer and Information System (IJCIS).
projects.image_file: Used Car Price Prediction Front Page.jpg

projects.title: FEAR
projects.subtitle: Augmented-reality exposure therapy app for iOS
projects.description: My final project at the Apple Developer Academy. FEAR is an iOS app that uses augmented reality for gradual exposure therapy. We built it in Swift and SwiftUI and based the design on user research.
projects.image_file: FEAR - Apple Developer Academy Final Project.jpg

projects.title: Tetandingan
projects.subtitle: 3D guide to traditional offerings
projects.description: A design and prototyping challenge at the Apple Developer Academy. Tetandingan is a 3D guide to traditional offerings, designed around mobile usability heuristics.
